lessons.title: Greetings & Introductions
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-001"
cando: "Can greet people, introduce oneself, and ask basic questions in spoken English."
task: "Speed-meeting roleplay: exchange names and greetings with 3 partners in 3 minutes."
speaking_focus: "Natural greeting intonation and clear vowel pronunciation in names."
lessons.recycled: Foundational communication & basic level vocabulary

lessons.title: Asking Simple Questions & Clarification
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-002"
cando: "Can ask simple questions and request clarification when speaking."
task: "Clarification repair exercise: listen to mumbled phrases and request repetition or clarification."
speaking_focus: "Rising intonation on polite clarification requests."
lessons.recycled: Verb 'to be' (present simple), Possessive adjectives (my, your), Nice to meet you

lessons.title: Personal Details: Origin & Numbers
grammar: Where + to be (Where are you from?)
Numbers 1-30 for age and phone numbers
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-003"
cando: "Can exchange personal details including origin, age, and phone numbers in conversation."
task: "Event registration roleplay: state full name, country of origin, age, and phone number to a partner."
speaking_focus: "Rhythmic digit grouping when dictating phone numbers aloud."
lessons.recycled: Question words (What, Where, How), Can for requests, Could you repeat that?

lessons.title: Everyday Courtesy & Social Polish
grammar: Polite modal triggers (Please, Thank you, Excuse me)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-004"
cando: "Can use essential courtesy phrases naturally in everyday social encounters."
task: "Doorway and hallway micro-simulations: practice passing, bumping, and thanking in realistic pairs."
speaking_focus: "Melodic rise-fall on 'You're welcome' and polite 'Excuse me'."
lessons.recycled: Where + to be (Where are you from?), Numbers 1-30 for age and phone numbers, Phone number

lessons.title: First Contact Fluency Roleplay & Unit Review
grammar: Synthesis of to be, question words, numbers, and politeness formulas
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-005"
cando: "Can carry out a complete 3-minute first-contact introduction dialogue fluently."
task: "Networking cocktail party simulation: circulate and complete 3 full introductory conversations."
speaking_focus: "Sustaining speech flow and handling unexpected questions without L1 pause."
lessons.recycled: Imperatives for social formulas, Polite modal triggers (Please, Thank you, Excuse me), Have a nice day

lessons.title: Basic Shopping & Ordering Phrases
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-006"
cando: "Can order food, drinks, and buy basic goods in shop transactions."
task: "Market stall interaction: order items from a price list and ask for the total bill."
speaking_focus: "Polite sentence stress on 'I would LIKE...' rather than blunt demands."
lessons.recycled: Pleased to meet you, Contact info, Polite modal triggers (Please, Thank you, Excuse me)

lessons.title: Asking for & Giving Directions
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-007"
cando: "Can ask for and give basic street directions."
task: "Map navigation dialogue: guide a partner through a city grid from station to museum."
speaking_focus: "Clear stress on directional keywords (LEFT, RIGHT, STRAIGHT)."
lessons.recycled: I would like..., How much is...?, Buy

lessons.title: Cafés, Snacks & Preferences
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-008"
cando: "Can order drinks and snacks in a café and state simple taste preferences."
task: "Café waiter and customer simulation: order a hot drink and snack, specifying milk or sugar."
speaking_focus: "Natural contracted forms in 'Can I have...' (/kənaɪ hæv/)."
lessons.recycled: Prepositions of place, Imperatives (Turn left, Go straight), How much is...?

lessons.title: Public Transport & Travel Tickets
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-009"
cando: "Can buy public transit tickets and ask about bus or train departure times."
task: "Ticket office roleplay: inquire about departure time, ticket price, and platform number."
speaking_focus: "Articulating times and numbers clearly in noisy public transit contexts."
lessons.recycled: Like / don't like + noun, Can I have...?, Straight ahead

lessons.title: Everyday Survival Roleplay & Unit Review
grammar: Synthesis of transactional request structures and direction imperatives
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-010"
cando: "Can navigate a multi-step city transaction (buying a ticket, asking directions, ordering a coffee)."
task: "3-station city survival circuit: complete tasks at transit kiosk, coffee shop, and street corner."
speaking_focus: "Smooth transition between transaction types and sustained spoken fluency."
lessons.recycled: Which ticket / Which train...?, Time prepositions, Platform, Delicious

lessons.title: Talking About Family & Friends
grammar: Have / Has got for family relationships
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-011"
cando: "Can introduce family members and describe basic family relationships in conversation."
task: "Photo album talk: show 3 photos (or draw family members) and describe relationships to a partner."
speaking_focus: "Pronouncing possessive 's clearly (/z/ vs /s/)."
lessons.recycled: Synthesis of transactional request structures, Help, Information desk

lessons.title: Describing Your Home & Space
grammar: Basic room prepositions (in the kitchen, on the table)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-012"
cando: "Can describe home layout and furniture items in spoken English."
task: "Home tour roleplay: guide a visitor through your apartment describing rooms and key items."
speaking_focus: "Distinguishing 'There is' (singular) and 'There are' (plural) in connected speech."
lessons.recycled: Possessive 's, Have / Has got for family relationships, Friend

lessons.title: Daily Routine & Daily Habits
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-013"
cando: "Can describe daily routines and habit frequency in conversation."
task: "Day-in-the-life exchange: interview partner about their typical morning and evening routine."
speaking_focus: "Correct placement of frequency adverbs BEFORE main verbs in speech."
lessons.recycled: There is / There are, Basic room prepositions, Flat

lessons.title: Telling Time & Schedules
grammar: What time is it? / At + exact time
Present simple question forms (What time do you...?)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-014"
cando: "Can ask and state clock times and discuss simple event schedules."
task: "Timetable alignment: compare daily calendars with a classmate to find a free time slot."
speaking_focus: "Rhythmic stress on time expressions (half past TEN, at FIVE o'clock)."
lessons.recycled: Present Simple (I / You / We / They), Frequency adverbs, Wake up

lessons.title: Personal Life Storytelling & Unit Review
grammar: Synthesis of Present Simple, habits, time connectors, and possessives
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-015"
cando: "Can present a 2-minute spoken summary of personal life, family, and weekly routines."
task: "Personal podcast introduction: record a 2-minute monologue about yourself, family, and daily routine."
speaking_focus: "Using sequence markers (First, Then, After that) for fluent monologue cohesion."
lessons.recycled: What time is it?, Present simple question forms, O'clock, Schedule

lessons.title: Professions & Workplace Tasks
grammar: Present Simple 3rd person singular intro (He/She works as...)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-016"
cando: "Can state job titles, work locations, and basic workplace responsibilities."
task: "Networking speed round: state your job (or student status) and workplace to 3 partners."
speaking_focus: "Using 'a' vs 'an' smoothly before consonant and vowel job titles."
lessons.recycled: Synthesis of Present Simple, habits, Typical day, Busy

lessons.title: Hobbies, Sports & Free Time
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-017"
cando: "Can discuss leisure interests, sports, and favorite free-time activities."
task: "Hobby matchmaker: interview classmates about hobbies to find shared interests."
speaking_focus: "Soft pronunciation of -ing suffix without harsh /ɡ/ sound."
lessons.recycled: A / An with job titles, Present Simple 3rd person singular intro, Company

lessons.title: Expressing Opinions & Simple Likes/Dislikes
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-018"
cando: "Can express simple opinions about movies, sports, or food with basic reasons."
task: "Opinion line-up: stand on a scale from 'Love it' to 'Hate it' for various activities and justify why."
speaking_focus: "Using enthusiastic or contrastive voice tone when giving opinions."
lessons.recycled: Like / Love / Enjoy + -ing, Play + sports, Swimming

lessons.title: Weekend Plans & Inviting Friends
grammar: Days of the week (on Saturday, on Sunday)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-019"
cando: "Can invite a partner to a weekend activity and accept or decline politely."
task: "Weekend planner roleplay: invite a friend to the park or cinema and agree on time/place."
speaking_focus: "Warm, enthusiastic intonation on 'Sounds good!' and polite regret when declining."
lessons.recycled: I think... / In my opinion..., Why + Because, Interesting

lessons.title: Social Inviting & Workplace Chat Roleplay
grammar: Synthesis of job descriptions, leisure preferences, and invitation structures
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-020"
cando: "Can engage in workplace small talk about hobbies and make lunch invitations fluently."
task: "Office coffee machine simulation: chat with a colleague about work and invite them to lunch."
speaking_focus: "Natural conversational pacing during spontaneous workplace small talk."
lessons.recycled: Do you want to...?, Days of the week, Weekend, Sounds good

lessons.title: At the Market: Quantities & Food Buying
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-021"
cando: "Can ask for specific quantities of food items at a market stall."
task: "Grocery market roleplay: buy ingredients for a recipe, asking for prices and weights."
speaking_focus: "Differentiating 'How much' (uncountable) vs 'How many' (countable) in rapid prompts."
lessons.recycled: Synthesis of job descriptions, Colleague, Lunch break

lessons.title: Clothes, Sizes & Trying Things On
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-022"
cando: "Can ask to try on clothes, request a different size, and comment on fit."
task: "Clothing boutique simulation: request a size medium shirt, try it on, and decide whether to buy."
speaking_focus: "Pronouncing demonstratives clearly (singular 'this/that' vs plural 'these/those')."
lessons.recycled: Some / Any with quantities, How much / How many...?, Kilo

lessons.title: At the Pharmacy & Basic Health Symptoms
grammar: I have + illness noun (I have a headache)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-023"
cando: "Can describe simple physical symptoms and ask for basic medication at a pharmacy."
task: "Pharmacist consultation: explain a headache or fever and ask for appropriate medicine."
speaking_focus: "Expressing physical discomfort clearly using 'I have a...'."
lessons.recycled: Demonstratives (this, that, these, those), Can I try this on?, Size

lessons.title: Asking for Help & Reporting Problems
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-024"
cando: "Can report a simple service problem (e.g., key card not working, broken item) politely."
task: "Hotel reception desk problem call: explain that the room Wi-Fi or key card is not working."
speaking_focus: "Maintaining polite tone ('Excuse me, there is a problem...') when making complaints."
lessons.recycled: I have + illness noun, Need + noun / infinitive, Pharmacy

lessons.title: Service Encounters & Problem Solving Review
grammar: Synthesis of shopping, health, and service problem-solving formulas
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-025"
cando: "Can resolve everyday commercial and service challenges in spoken dialogue fluently."
task: "Service desk challenge: resolve a multi-step situation involving a wrong item and refund request."
speaking_focus: "Sustaining communicative confidence during real-time service exchanges."
lessons.recycled: There is a problem with..., Can you help me?, Broken, Manager

lessons.title: Talking About Yesterday (Past Simple 'To Be')
grammar: Past time markers (yesterday, last night, ago)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-026"
cando: "Can talk about where you were yesterday and describe past states or locations."
task: "Yesterday's location check: interview classmate about where they were at various times yesterday."
speaking_focus: "Pronouncing 'was' (/wəz/) and 'were' (/wɜː/) accurately without over-stressing."
lessons.recycled: Synthesis of shopping, health, and service problem-solving, Receipt, Urgent

lessons.title: Sharing Past Weekend Activities
grammar: Past Simple regular (-ed) & key irregular verbs (went, had, bought, saw)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-027"
cando: "Can narrate basic past weekend events using common past simple verbs."
task: "Monday morning catch-up: recount 3 things you did last weekend to a group of colleagues."
speaking_focus: "Correct past -ed endings (/t/, /d/, /ɪd/) and key irregular past forms."
lessons.recycled: Was / Were, Past time markers, Yesterday

lessons.title: Future Plans & Intentions ('Going to')
grammar: Be going to + verb for future plans
Future time markers (tomorrow, next week, next month)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-028"
cando: "Can state future personal plans, travel intentions, and upcoming events."
task: "Bucket list sharing: talk about 3 things you are going to do next summer or next year."
speaking_focus: "Natural reduced pronunciation of 'going to' (/ɡənə/) in casual speech."
lessons.recycled: Past Simple regular & key irregular verbs, Did you...?, Went, Met

lessons.title: Spontaneous Offers & Simple Predictions
grammar: Will / Won't for spontaneous offers and simple predictions
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-029"
cando: "Can make spontaneous offers of assistance and simple weather predictions in conversation."
task: "Helping hand roleplay: respond to partner's situational problems with spontaneous 'I'll help you' offers."
speaking_focus: "Contraction 'I'll' (/aɪl/) in immediate spoken offers."
lessons.recycled: Be going to + verb, Future time markers, Tomorrow, Vacation

lessons.title: A1 Spoken Capstone: Personal Story & Fluency Review
grammar: Synthesis of Present Simple, Past Simple, and Future 'Going to'
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-SPK-A1-030"
cando: "Can present a coherent 3-minute spoken personal narrative combining past, present, and future."
task: "A1 Showcase Monologue: deliver a 3-minute talk covering where you are from, your daily routine, a past memory, and future plans."
speaking_focus: "Smooth tense transitions between past memory, present routine, and future aspirations."
lessons.recycled: Will / Won't for spontaneous offers, Be going to, Past Simple, Present Simple
